casePin.finding: streamed-mapping.ts validatePlanTx refuses a plan whose caseRevision differs from the profile job's input caseRevision, and no route published that value; ST1's StreamedLayoutAnswer pinned the case's current revision, so a layout authored after another file joined the batch was refused with 409 'The source case revision changed.'
casePin.fix: StreamedProfileStatusSchema gains caseRevision (the profile job input's caseRevision, the value validatePlanTx compares); statusTx fills it from input.caseRevision. The Studio pins the status it already reads (CasePin = Pick<ProfileStatus,'caseId'|'caseRevision'>) and no longer reads the source case.
casePin.regression: StreamedLayoutAnswer.test.tsx 'pins the inventory's case revision after the case has advanced': the case read is seeded at revision 9, the inventory status at 7; the authored plan pins 7. Run against the ST1 component (1064fcaf) it fails with 'expected 9 to be 7'; with this change it passes.

history.finding: GET /api/v1/ingestion/cases/{caseId}/recipes/{recipeId} returns streamed receipts at runtime (ST1 d6) but published z.array(AnyMappingReceiptSchema) only.
history.fix: The route publishes z.array(z.union([...AnyMappingReceiptSchema.options, StreamedMappingReceiptSchema])); ManualIngestionService.read is typed to match. The Studio's batch Recipe is again the history's published element type (the ST1 widening is removed).
history.shape: A flat three-member union. Nesting AnyMappingReceiptSchema inside a new union re-indented the existing members (openapi.json +1444/-845); the flat union is additive only (+595/-0).
history.tableReader: apps/studio table/recipe-api.ts readRecipe already refuses any revision that is not manual-tabular/1; its RecipeHistory type now names Recipe[] after that check, so the table page's types stay as before.
history.regression: StreamedLayoutAnswer.test.tsx 'publishes a streamed receipt in the recipe history and the inventory's own case revision': a streamed receipt validates against the published history schema; a status validates with caseRevision and fails without it.
